apply.description: Close and reopen issues. When false (the default) the run only reports.

ledger.description: Path of the ledger in the calling repository.

max_actions.description: The most closes plus reopens one run may perform (0 to 50).

steps.name: Checkout caller repository (full history, as for every evaluation)
Assert this reusable's own commit resolved
steps.run:
if ! printf '%s' "$SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'; then
  echo "::error::job.workflow_sha resolved to '${SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA:-<empty>}', not a 40-hex commit, so the evaluator checkout below would follow the default branch."
  exit 1
fi
echo "Evaluator source: metadatastician/standards@$SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA"

steps.name: Checkout the evaluator at this reusable's own commit
Stage the evaluator outside the evaluated tree
Run the script checks (only these)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-evidence.sh" evaluate --scripts-only --repo "$REPO" --ref HEAD "$LEDGER" \
  >"$RUNNER_TEMP/script-results.jsonl"
echo "script checks run: $(jq -s length "$RUNNER_TEMP/script-results.jsonl")"
echo "results=$(jq -c -s . "$RUNNER_TEMP/script-results.jsonl")" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Checkout caller repository (full history, for commit-on-main checks)
Assert this reusable's own commit resolved
steps.run:
if ! printf '%s' "$SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'; then
  echo "::error::job.workflow_sha resolved to '${SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA:-<empty>}', not a 40-hex commit, so the evaluator checkout below would follow the default branch."
  exit 1
fi
echo "Evaluator source: metadatastician/standards@$SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA"

steps.name: Checkout the evaluator at this reusable's own commit
Stage the evaluator outside the evaluated tree
Is this the default branch?
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
default="$(gh api "repos/$REPO" --jq .default_branch)"
if [ "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/$default" ]; then
  echo "on_default=true" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "on_default=false" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "::notice::$GITHUB_REF is not the default branch ($default): report only, nothing will be applied."
fi

steps.name: Validate the ledger
Evaluate every row at this commit, with the scripts job's outcomes
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "$SCRIPT_RESULTS" ]; then
  echo "::error::the scripts job published no results; refusing to evaluate."
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s' "$SCRIPT_RESULTS" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/script-results.json"
jq -c 'if type == "array" then .[] else error("the scripts job output is not a JSON array") end' \
  "$RUNNER_TEMP/script-results.json" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/script-results.jsonl"
bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-evidence.sh" evaluate --repo "$REPO" --ref HEAD \
  --script-results "$RUNNER_TEMP/script-results.jsonl" "$LEDGER" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/evaluated.jsonl"
echo "rows evaluated: $(jq -s length "$RUNNER_TEMP/evaluated.jsonl")"

steps.name: Read the ledger issues' states
Issues the bot closed whose row was removed
Decide
Plan (capped)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-evidence-apply.sh" select --decisions "$RUNNER_TEMP/decisions.jsonl" \
  --max-actions "$MAX_ACTIONS" --removed "$RUNNER_TEMP/removed.jsonl" \
  --counts "$RUNNER_TEMP/counts" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/selected.jsonl"
bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-evidence-apply.sh" plan --repo "$REPO" --selected "$RUNNER_TEMP/selected.jsonl" \
  --evaluated "$RUNNER_TEMP/evaluated.jsonl" --ledger "$LEDGER" --commit HEAD >"$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.json"
echo "plan=$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.json")" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "plan_count=$(jq length "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.json")" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Candidate rows (report only)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git log --format='%H%x09%s%x09%b%x1e' HEAD >"$RUNNER_TEMP/log.txt"
gh issue list --repo "$REPO" --state open --limit 2000 --json number \
  --jq '[.[] | {number, state: "open"}]' >"$RUNNER_TEMP/open-issues.json"
bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-evidence.sh" candidates --log "$RUNNER_TEMP/log.txt" \
  --open "$RUNNER_TEMP/open-issues.json" --repo "$REPO" "$LEDGER" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/candidates.jsonl"

steps.name: Job summary (always)
steps.run:
{
  echo "## Issue evidence"
  echo
  if [ ! -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/decisions.jsonl" ]; then
    echo "**No decision table: an earlier step failed (see its log). Nothing was applied.**"
  else
    read -r total planned 2>/dev/null <"$RUNNER_TEMP/counts" || { total="?"; planned=0; }
    if [ "$APPLY" = true ] && [ "$ON_DEFAULT" = true ]; then
      echo "Mode: **apply** (the apply job performs the planned actions)."
    elif [ "$APPLY" = true ]; then
      echo "Mode: **report only**: this is not the default branch."
    else
      echo "Mode: **report only** (apply is off; the caller turns it on)."
    fi
    echo
    echo "Actions decided: $total. Planned this run: $planned (cap $MAX_ACTIONS)."
    if [ "$total" != "?" ] && [ "$total" -gt "$planned" ]; then
      echo
      echo "**Cap reached: $((total - planned)) further action(s) were NOT planned. They are taken on later runs, $MAX_ACTIONS at a time.**"
    fi
    echo
    echo "| Issue | Disposition | Holds | Failed checks | Action | Reason |"
    echo "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"
    jq -r -s --slurpfile ev "$RUNNER_TEMP/evaluated.jsonl" '
      ($ev | map({key: (.issue | tostring), value: .}) | from_entries) as $e
      | .[] | ($e[.issue | tostring]) as $r
      | "| #\(.issue) | \(.disposition) | \($r.holds) | \($r.failed | map(tostring) | join(", ")) | \(.action) | \(.reason) |"' \
      "$RUNNER_TEMP/decisions.jsonl"
  fi
  if [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/removed.jsonl" ]; then
    echo
    echo "### Rows removed after the bot closed their issue"
    echo
    echo "Each is reopened, within the cap, with a comment saying its row was removed."
    echo
    echo "| Issue | Action |"
    echo "|---|---|"
    jq -r '"| #\(.issue) | reopen (row removed) |"' "$RUNNER_TEMP/removed.jsonl"
  fi
  if [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/candidates.jsonl" ]; then
    echo
    echo "### Candidate rows (report only, top 20)"
    echo
    echo "Open issues with no ledger row that commits on this branch mention. A row is written by a person, checked, and merged in a reviewed PR."
    echo
    echo "| Issue | Commits | Closing keyword |"
    echo "|---|---|---|"
    head -n 20 "$RUNNER_TEMP/candidates.jsonl" | jq -r '"| #\(.issue) | \(.mentions) | \(.closing_keyword) |"'
  fi
} >>"$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Fetch the applier and the evaluator at this reusable's own commit
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if ! printf '%s' "$SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'; then
  echo "::error::job.workflow_sha resolved to '${SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA:-<empty>}', not a 40-hex commit; refusing to act."
  exit 1
fi
for s in issue-evidence-apply.sh issue-evidence.sh; do
  gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' \
    "repos/metadatastician/standards/contents/scripts/$s?ref=$SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/$s"
  head -n 1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/$s" | grep -qx '#!/usr/bin/env bash' || {
    echo "::error::the fetched $s is not the expected script; refusing to act."
    exit 1
  }
done

steps.name: Verify the plan against the ledger, then close and reopen
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s' "$PLAN" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.json"
bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-evidence-apply.sh" verify-plan --repo "$REPO" --commit "$EVALUATED_SHA" \
  --ledger "$LEDGER" --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.json" --max-actions "$MAX_ACTIONS" \
  --evaluator "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-evidence.sh" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/verified-plan.json"
bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-evidence-apply.sh" apply --repo "$REPO" \
  --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/verified-plan.json" --max-actions "$MAX_ACTIONS" \
  --commit "$EVALUATED_SHA"
